pages.text: These artifacts are in the Isis Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Isis to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
Wear this amulet in a Curios necklace slot. While you are below full health, it heals one health point at intervals of roughly nine seconds.
A bow that splits the shot into two arrows. Charge it before shooting to improve the volley.
